lenses.label: ESO · optical
lenses.title: Orion in visible light
lenses.description: Source-colored relative emission fitted to aligned ESO images. Its coherent depth surface is an evidence-guided hypothesis, not measured gas density. Compact-light positions and display photometry are image-derived; their depths are conditional, not measured stellar distances. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D color fitting. Surrounding optical stars use Gaia positions and parallax-informed distances; their brightness/color display is independent of this spectral image.
lenses.summary: Optical display colors on an inferred cloud; physical depth and faint outer structure remain uncertain.
